title: Vortex Escape
description:
Your ship is caught in a vortex, survive by moving the ship out of the coming obstacles and achieve the highest possible survival times. On the way you have a helper orb to assist you.

Key features• Elegant, minimalistic level design

• Challenging, fast paced and fun gameplay

• Randomly generated levels

• Single-player

How to Play
The Helper Orb is linked to the mouse pointer, this helps the player escape more easily by anticipating the ship's position.
description_short: Your ship is caught in a vortex, try to escape while avoiding obstacles. On the way you have a helper orb to assist you.
